vb_textbox.text: When picking a gnome, I tried various combinations of what I thought could provide a high score eg. hat size, colour, gnome size, left or right. The best I found was a cycle of the more muted gnomes giving more mushrooms, then when this decreased, I would try the more colourful gnomes which provided more. Sometimes this did not work for a few rounds and I found both to give less than 5 but this was the best combination I could find during the experiment.
